# mcu-max

The [Litch-Max engine](../../lib/litch-max/README.md) includes a modified copy of Gissio’s mcu-max 1.0.7, derived from H.G. Muller’s micro-Max 4.8. The [pinned library manifest](../../lib/litch-max.snapshot.json) identifies the version used by Litch.

The [engine provenance](../../lib/litch-max/docs/mcu_max_provenance.md) records the upstream commit, local changes, MIT notice and author’s permission for micro-Max. See the [vendored MIT license](../../lib/litch-max/vendor/mcu-max/LICENSE) and [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) when redistributing the engine. The [vendor comparison tool](../../tools/vendor/README.md) can verify the changes against upstream.
